title: Switch-Reasoner: Learn When to Think in Multitask Mixtures via Reinforcement Learning

access.version_observed: PDF p.1 arXiv:2607.08572v1 [cs.CV] 9 Jul 2026; latest online version not checked
sections_read: 3.1 GRPO pp.3–4; 3.2 Thinking-as-Tool p.4; 3.3 controller/3.4 counterfactual sampling p.5; 3.4 labels/3.5 reward pp.5–6, Eqs1–17/Fig2
App.A notation/Table2 p.14; App.B four detailed prompts pp.14–15; App.C Algorithm1 pp.15–16
App.D dataset and evaluation/Table3 pp.16–17; App.E parameters/ablation Table4 pp.17–18; App.F cases/Figs6–7 pp.18–19

rs.innovation_approach: 将固定的先思考再回答改为显式虚拟工具路由，用上一batch模式统计控制加当前策略双模式反事实rollout标签，共同塑造GRPO轨迹奖励。
rs.key_step: 每题额外强制direct/think各K4次，以成功率差和direct可靠性阈值分must-think/safe-direct/uncertain；对自然switchable rollout按是否匹配该类别加±.03，而全局信号只惩罚暂时过用且相对不利的模式。
rs.why_non_obvious: 全局维持两种模式不等于逐题选择正确；强制分支可观察罕见路线的表现，却不自动给主策略提供该动作的梯度样本。
rs.trigger_condition: When a fixed deliberation policy wastes computation and outcome-only training favors one route, expose a discrete route and combine delayed population control with current-policy route comparisons.
rs.acceptance_signal: low_evidence: manifest decision=null and no reviews_path; no review note source available.
rs.abstract_strategy: Make a fixed processing stage optional and regulate its global use separately from instance-level benefit.
rs.abstract_key_step: Sample both alternatives under controlled prompts, abstain from uncertain preferences, and apply signed preference rewards to ordinary trajectories.
rs.abstract_why_non_obvious: Population balance and instance utility are different quantities; observing an alternative does not guarantee learning support for choosing it.
rs.abstract_trigger_condition: When shared optimization collapses heterogeneous cases to one behavior, combine population-level feedback with conservative per-instance preference estimates.

limitations.text: 作者只展示Qwen3-VL4B/8B这组实验；没有其它adaptive方法的同预算比较。引文是实验范围，后半为读者审计边界。
limitations.quote:
We use Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct and Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct as
vanilla base models (Bai et al., 2025) for RL training. We compare our method with Vanilla model,
all-thinking and all-direct variants, as well as a variant without sample-level fine-grained correction,
to evaluate the effects of switchable reasoning and instance-level route supervision.

limitations.text: 作者直接报告的negative trade-off：宽松safe-direct损害overall。
limitations.quote:
a stronger effect on the accuracy-efficiency trade-off: a loose criterion substantially reduces the
thinking rate but also hurts overall performance, while a stricter criterion preserves stronger accuracy
with a moderate thinking rate.

limitations.text: 仅binary switching已测，更丰富工具为未来方向；不等同多轮crop决策。
limitations.quote:
Beyond binary
switching, this tool-based formulation may support richer reasoning tools and adaptive allocation of
thinking resources.

question.observed_failure: 固定all-think4B overall70.66、think100%；all-direct65.02、think0%；full71.60、think51.53。global-only4B仍85.73%think，显示全局统计不能替代逐题分配。论文对“accuracy-only自由路由塌缩”的独立数值实验未给。
question.load_bearing_assumption: 所有题固定先思考，或只靠终答reward/单一全局mode偏好，就足以学到稳定的逐题思考必要性。
question.scope: Qwen3-VL4B/8B-Instruct，11个异质图像任务，首轮二元虚拟thinking tool，GRPO+EasyR1；不是外部视觉信息获取或多轮工具credit。
question.success_criterion: 作者以overall task score和think rate联合衡量；没有预注册非劣界、token/latency终点或独立route utility金标。
question.why_open: early-exit/prune在已经开始思考后缩短输出，不能替代是否开始；adaptive已有方法多阶段/日程复杂，本文把问题限制为异质混合中的route稳定性和sample收益。

For each input qi , we evaluate the current policy under two fixed choices: Direct Mode and Thinking
Mode. Specifically, we construct a direct prompt that forces an answer without invoking the thinking
tool and a thinking prompt that requires explicit reasoning before the final answer:
moves.mapping_note: 同一原始图/题、当前策略强制两路线比较；不同prompt并非严格相同决策前hidden state，不能称完全满足共享h契约。

moves.mapping_note: K2/4/8与must-think margin单参数改变；safe-direct loose/strict同时改两阈值、权重臂同时改两权重，不把这些称完全单变量。

moves.quote:
On Qwen3-VL-8B, Switch-Reasoner also achieves the best overall score, reaching 72.22 with only
a 37.73% thinking rate.
moves.mapping_note: 同时报告score/think率，实际执行性能-效率对照；未完成严格非劣或真实成本评估。

moves.quote:
When the thinking tool is invoked, a follow-up think-tool response switches the model into Thinking
Mode and requires intermediate reasoning before the final answer. Otherwise, the model outputs
the answer directly. During rollout, the model first follows the switchable protocol; a tool call
continues the trajectory with the follow-up think-tool response, while a direct answer is treated as
a Direct-answering-mode trajectory. Generation can therefore be viewed as an implicit two-stage
process: mode selection followed by either direct answering or explicit reasoning.
moves.mapping_note: 将固定先思考的生成阶段改为可学习二元设计变量。

moves.quote:
We therefore
introduce Sample-level Fine-grained Optimization to provide counterfactual route supervision for
each training sample.
moves.mapping_note: 用自身双模式rollout制造缺失的route preference标签；仍依赖金答案reward，绝不称label-free correctness supervision。

moves.quote:
must-think indicates that Thinking Mode provides a clear improvement. In contrast,
safe-direct is assigned only when Direct Mode is already reliable and Thinking Mode does not
provide a sufficient benefit; in our default setting, this requires the empirical thinking gain to fall
below a negative safety margin. For uncertain samples, we impose no strong preference to avoid
introducing noisy route supervision.
moves.mapping_note: 按差值与direct可靠性三分样本，给正负或零路由信号；是实际差异处理，不是把全局/局部两模块名称视为分解。

objective.signal_routing: Algorithm1先G条natural switchable rollouts、额外2K forced-route rollouts估s/标签、再给主rollouts算r*和组优势；未写将forced-route轨迹加入GRPO或进行单独SFT/BCE。route信息虽来自首决策比较，最终进入scalar trajectory reward，不是仅首动作token监督、也不是caption/crop/answer局部routing。Eq1只给输出序列比率，未给实际token mask、turn拼接、长度归约、对环境think-tool response的mask；不能自动补常见EasyR1实现。uncertain仅route=0，base/global/KL仍有效。格式无效轨迹只明确从controller计数排除，m和route/global评分fallback未给。
objective.normalization_notes: Sec3.1明确population std的1/G，未写数值epsilon或zero-variance guard。r_base先乘global gate后加route，再统一减组均值除std；无分通道标准化。式13的epsilon_B阈值不等于std稳定项，PPO clip值与B阈值均未报。K4成功率为.25格点；同题label对主组共享。
objective.invariance: 无最优策略不变性保证：mode penalty和signed route reward均改目标，不是potential shaping或动作无关baseline。读者推导：同组共同正倍scale与常数shift被严格mean/std消去；仅在两模式的惩罚不同、或base/route相对排序变化时有新方向。等base且route唯一变化时w=.03被std约掉；不表示所有一般组中权重无效。若整组只有同一mode且label固定，则r*=c*r_base+k，标准化与原base相同（σ>0），global与route控制均失去该组新的mode信号。B符号超过epsilon后Bg/Bf绝对幅度不进入Eq13，仅影响门是否开；不是连续强度调节器。
objective.baseline_or_potential: 组平均最终reward是baseline；ref policy用于KL而非路线成功估值。路线s由当前策略强制prompt抽样MC终答正确性；controller mode平均accuracy来自自选择自然轨迹且有task composition confound。无critic/冻结reader/potential。
objective.degenerate_cases: 读者推导：所有r*相同则σ=0，原式0/0，实现guard未知；全对组不必无梯度（两模式route/global仍可不同），全错格式合法可由format base或route产生信号，取决于未知alpha。两模式base全0时乘η无效但route仍可能有差。K4下must-think需n_t−n_d≥2，safe-direct需n_d≥3且n_d−n_t≥1；(4,4)/(0,0)均uncertain。uncertain≠不进loss。p≈0/1额外forced branch仍有标签，但主组无缺失动作梯度样本，safeguard不保证恢复；某mode计数0使其accuracy未定义，所有invalid使usage0/0，fallback未报。单轮协议仅一次think选择，不能表达第j次crop必要性/重新观察。

evidence_design.discriminating_experiment: Table1 full vs SR*测试sample correction在固定global框架上的贡献；Table4改K/margins/weights观察敏感性。Fig3 validation轨迹及Fig4各dataset think率说明不只是全局统一频率。未给同总体think率随机/常数router、打乱route labels、无global/无safeguard或等训练compute对照，不能独立识别每个模块和逐题语义作用。
controls: 同Qwen3-VL4B/8B骨干的all-thinking/all-direct/Vanilla/SR*；无Thinkless/AdaCoT等已提及adaptive方法的实验对照。
Table4 K=2/4/8；must-think .25/.5/.75单参数改变；safe loose(.60,0)/strict(.90,.50)同时改两个阈值；weight实验同时变两weight。
主结果为最后3个validation步骤均值/std，不是3独立seed，未给独立封存test和训练/验证split规模及样本泄漏核验。
Table3 mixed metrics：DocVQA ANLS、ChartQA relaxed accuracy、RefAdv IoU@.5、其余任务specific ACC；overall不是统一二项accuracy。
Fig5–7选例展示route，不能替代随机抽样错误分析或必要性label一致性验证。

pitfalls.text: controller只计格式可识别轨迹，避免把invalid误作direct；这并未规定invalid的训练reward处理。
pitfalls.quote:
Only format-valid trajectories are used because malformed outputs cannot reliably reflect the actual
reasoning-mode decision.

pitfalls.text: 延迟一batch更新避免用当前已经调整的reward统计即时反馈；B须可持久化和记录。
pitfalls.quote:
The updated control signal is stored and used in the next training
iteration.

pitfalls.text: safe-direct默认负安全margin要求直答比思考更好；边界两支一样好不能当safe-direct。
pitfalls.quote:
safe-direct is assigned only when Direct Mode is already reliable and Thinking Mode does not
provide a sufficient benefit; in our default setting, this requires the empirical thinking gain to fall
below a negative safety margin.

pitfalls.text: counterfactual prompt和实际think-tool continuation文本不同，需要自然/forced校准，不能只因公式π(o|q,m)写得一样就默认无混杂。
pitfalls.quote:
I noticed you tried to call a tool. Please do not call any tools.
Now You FIRST think about the reasoning process as an internal
monologue and then provide the final answer. Put your concise
reasoning inside <thinking>...</thinking>, and put the final
answer inside <answer>...</answer>.

engineering.code_notes: Paper p.1 supplied URL; repository not fetched, executed or implementation-verified. EasyR1 URL p.7 is framework provenance, not pinned config.
engineering.lesson: 当混合任务把一种模式挤出时，分开记录natural主组与forced测量分支、valid/invalid计数、逐题标签和控制器前后reward；先检查控制项经过std后是否仍有mode梯度。把uncertain当“不加route偏好”而非丢样本，并核对强制prompt标签对自然路由的可迁移性；最后以真实token/latency及独立非劣验证效率。

relevance.how: 相同4B族的按题思考/直答结果，global+local奖励可作近邻；无crop新信息与严格非劣验证。
